notes: Document timeOrigin + FCP minus process spawn epoch; not automation connection time.
Main dataset was collected before input assertions were added. Visibility, load and FCP were verified from its saved documents.
Balanced experiment reverses condition order on odd rounds. Exploratory fixed-order A/B is excluded.
No managed-window aggregate is available for main: exploratory observer stopped on an X11 BadWindow race. Fixed observer covers all balanced and later samples.
Enumerated PSS/CPU cover only processes still listed by CDP at sampling, excluding helpers it does not enumerate.
Synthetic background tabs are not visited except in cases ending in -visited.
Trace phase durations are inclusive and must not be summed with children.
Trace task source/function denotes the posting site, not a separately instrumented duration of that function.
